# GitHub Copilot Prompt Templates

Reusable prompt templates for common development tasks in the ck3-language-support VS Code extension.

## Available Templates

### CK3 / LSP Development

- [Adding New CK3 Language Features.prompt.md](Adding%20New%20CK3%20Language%20Features.prompt.md) — Add new language features to the extension
- [LSP Feature Implementation.prompt.md](LSP%20Feature%20Implementation.prompt.md) — Implement LSP protocol features
- [Debugging LSP Server Issues.prompt.md](Debugging%20LSP%20Server%20Issues.prompt.md) — Troubleshoot language server issues
- [Test Writing Best Practices.prompt.md](Test%20Writing%20Best%20Practices.prompt.md) — Write tests for extension code
- [VS Code Extension Packaging.prompt.md](VS%20Code%20Extension%20Packaging.prompt.md) — Package and publish the extension

### Project Documentation

- [architecture_and_flow.md](architecture_and_flow.md) — Architecture and module interaction flow
- [ascii_art_architecture_documentation.md](ascii_art_architecture_documentation.md) — ASCII art architecture diagrams
- [documentation_standard.md](documentation_standard.md) — Inline documentation standards

### Git / GitHub Workflow

- [Branch Creation Assistant.prompt.md](Branch%20Creation%20Assistant.prompt.md) — Branch naming and creation
- [Branch Merge Assistant.prompt.md](Branch%20Merge%20Assistant.prompt.md) — Branch merging workflow
- [Commit Message Assistant.prompt.md](Commit%20Message%20Assistant.prompt.md) — Conventional commit messages
- [Version Update Assistant.prompt.md](Version%20Update%20Assistant.prompt.md) — Version bumping across files
- [Guided-PRD-Creation.prompt.md](Guided-PRD-Creation.prompt.md) — Product requirements documents

### GitHub CLI (`gh`)

- [gh pr create.prompt.md](gh%20pr%20create.prompt.md) / [gh pr review.prompt.md](gh%20pr%20review.prompt.md) — Pull request workflows
- [gh issue create.prompt.md](gh%20issue%20create.prompt.md) / [gh issue edit.prompt.md](gh%20issue%20edit.prompt.md) / [gh issue list.prompt.md](gh%20issue%20list.prompt.md) — Issue management
- [gh run view.prompt.md](gh%20run%20view.prompt.md) / [gh run list.prompt.md](gh%20run%20list.prompt.md) / [gh run rerun.prompt.md](gh%20run%20rerun.prompt.md) — CI run monitoring
- [gh pr checks.prompt.md](gh%20pr%20checks.prompt.md) / [gh pr merge.prompt.md](gh%20pr%20merge.prompt.md) / [gh release delete.prompt.md](gh%20release%20delete.prompt.md) — Additional `gh` commands

## How to Use

1. Open the template file
2. Copy the prompt
3. Replace placeholders (marked with `{PLACEHOLDER}`)
4. Paste into Copilot chat
5. Follow the generated guidance
